_comment_hiddenApi: Session TEARDOWN restores the device's hidden-API policy via adb. On a wireless device that adb call fails whenever the handset is briefly unreachable, and the error is thrown from a callback with no handler — killing the whole Appium SERVER, not just the session. That is what ended two long runs (failures 42-50 and 90-100, contiguous to the end, exactly when a server died). This capability makes the driver tolerate that failure.
